data.name: budget
data.shape: ReadBudgetResult — 'budget' {limits, unbounded, warnings, halted, sizing, block} | 'unreadable' {reason, cause}
data.source: app.readBudget.execute — one get_agent_budget call, whose gauges the platform has already resolved

data.name: reading
data.shape: RiskReading — ceilings, geometry, management, exposure, each its own Reading<T>
data.source: app.readRiskReading.execute — the agent's settings read against what makes them safe or unsafe

data.name: lossShape
data.source: app.readLossShape.execute — how the loss behind the stop arrived

data.name: roster
data.source: app.listAgents.execute — read for the agent's name and its 24h spend, which no other read answers truthfully

components.purpose: Answer one question — what would stop this agent, and how close is it — with the limits that cannot stop it named rather than left as calm rows.
components.current_implementation: Centred column with `AgentPageHeading`, then `<Ceilings>`, `<RiskReadingPanel>` and `<LossShapePanel>`. Every reading is computed in its query; the page imports no domain (W-D) and renders four independently-failing sources.
constraints: The four reads fail independently and one failure must not blank the others — `A Summary Assembled Around A Refusal Says What It Could Not Reach`. A design must not unify them into a single skeleton or error state.
The page imports no domain type. Readings arrive shaped by their queries.
This is a read-only surface. It offers no control that changes an agent, and adding one would change behaviour and is requires-spec-change.

components.purpose: How close the agent is to each ceiling that could stop it — and which ceilings do not exist.
components.current_implementation: `<Ceilings>` (ceilings.tsx). Binding limits sort first; unbounded ones are named in their own list rather than shown as rows. A halt renders a consequence-tinted role=alert at the top.
constraints: **A gauge with no ceiling must never render a number for its headroom.** The platform sends `remaining: 0` there, and '0 remaining' says the opposite of what it means — `A Limit Nobody Set Is Not A Limit Of Zero`.
The unbounded list is load-bearing: four calm rows read as an agent operating inside its limits when the truth may be that it has none.
Every reading is computed in `ReadBudgetQuery`; this component formats and never derives.

components.purpose: What is left under the exposure cap, and that new entries are sized from the remainder rather than stopped by the ceiling.
components.current_implementation: `SizingPanel` in ceilings.tsx — a bordered block showing committed / left, the sentence naming the remainder as the sizing base, what the platform reports it authorizes, and the consequence: below the exchange minimum, entries stop being placed and BattleGrid does not say why. Renders nothing at all when the cap is unconfigured or absent.
constraints: **No projected order size, and no exchange-floor comparison.** That figure is `headroom x sizePct x effectiveLeverage`; the preset is this product's to apply and the platform publishes no per-preset projection. `the-approval-can-be-answered` refused the same formula as PE-2 on the neighbouring money surface. `tests/agent/sizing-base.test.ts` scans this file with comments stripped, so the rule can be explained here without tripping its own guard.
Renders nothing for an unconfigured cap — an unbounded cap has no proportion to be full of, and `0% used` would describe a limit that does not exist.
Every figure is the platform's, rendered as sent. `get_agent_budget`'s own description says of the gauges: *render them, never re-derive*.

The mechanism sentence is the point of the section. A relayout may move it but must not drop it — the remaining figure alone reads as room to keep going, which is the misreading that makes the failure invisible.

components.purpose: State a budget-side stop the platform names itself, rather than leaving it to be inferred from an agent that went quiet.
components.current_implementation: `BlockedNotice` in ceilings.tsx — a consequence-tinted role=alert carrying the platform's own reason and the time it began.
constraints: Where the platform blocked an agent and gave no reason, the notice says so. **No explanation may be substituted** — a guess here would acquire the platform's authority.
The absence of a block is not rendered as a reassurance. Nothing is shown when nothing is reported.

components.purpose: Each setting shown against the thing that makes it safe or unsafe — the ceilings against their platform defaults, the exit geometry, the management preset, and the exposure cap against the account balance.
components.current_implementation: `<RiskReadingPanel>` (risk-reading.tsx). Four independent `Reading<T>` sections, each stating its own failure.
constraints: The balance is described as **the account's**, never the agent's — one balance funds every agent, and a per-agent framing overstates the money available by the number of agents sharing it.
A derived figure says it is derived; the measurement window is stated rather than implied.
Each of the four sections fails alone. A design must not collapse them into one error state.

components.purpose: How the loss behind the drawdown stop actually arrived — the curve, not just the figure.
constraints: An empty curve is a legitimate state — the platform defines it as no settlements yet, not as missing data — and must not render as a failure.

components.purpose: Say whether a failed read was a refusal or an outage, because the two have different next steps.
components.current_implementation: Shared `WhyNotLoaded`, mounted per failing source so one failure names itself without claiming the others.
constraints: The refused/unreachable distinction is spec-bearing — telling somebody with a bad credential to wait out an outage that is not happening is the mistake this component exists to stop.

flows.name: Find out what would stop this agent
steps: read which ceilings bind and which do not exist
read how full the exposure cap is and that entries are sized from what is left
read each setting against what makes it safe or unsafe

flows.name: Understand why an agent went quiet
steps: see the exposure cap filling and the remainder shrinking
read that entries are sized from the remainder and stop below the exchange minimum
or, where the platform names a block, read the block with its own reason

flows.name: One source fails
steps: the failing section states its reason and whether it was refused or unreachable
the other three sections still render

accessibility.notes: The halt notice, the warnings and the blocked notice all carry role=alert and can be on screen together. Read-only surface: no forms, no client state, full-page navigation throughout.
